narrative:
## Handover Summary — Launch & Lifecycle

Lifecycle events are modelled FY2025 vs FY2026 by market, and each one reconciles to the revenue targets.

## Key Decisions
• Soliris PNH erosion slowed on the European tender evidence
• Voydeya US add-on uptake raised on EVH screening rates
• Koselugo Europe adult transition included

## Recommendation for Market Access
The Market Access Director should confirm that reimbursement timelines in Europe and China support the Koselugo and Ultomiris gMG ramps assumed here.
